button.swt-bar-icon [aria-label="Filter" aria-pressed="false" tabindex="-1" title="Show or hide the filter row (hidden, the filters still apply: the toolbar and the headers show them)" type="button"]

button.swt-bar-icon [aria-label="Edit mode" aria-pressed="false" tabindex="-1" title="Off: a click selects a cell; a second click, a double click, Enter or typing edits it. Click to edit on the first click" type="button"]
button.swt-bar-icon [aria-label="Lazy saving" aria-pressed="false" tabindex="-1" title="Lazy saving: cells edited are saved together, a moment after editing stops" type="button"]
button.swt-bar-icon.swt-bar-more [aria-label="More" tabindex="-1" title="More for this table" type="button"]
